evals.prompt: A worker says the new settings page is done and passes. The site is built and served at http://127.0.0.1:3000 and the page is /settings. Verify it properly before I merge. We care about light and dark and phones.
evals.expected_output: Runs the gate on /settings in light and dark at 320 and 1440 with lints, axe and overflow; does not just trust the worker; reports real numbers and what was not tested.

evals.prompt: We just rebuilt the docs site from the old single-page reference at ./reference/page.html. Drive through the whole thing and give me screenshots so I can review everything works as expected, every case you can think of.
evals.expected_output: Launches or briefs a separate QA worker with playwright-cli covering controls, keyboard, open states and console errors; compares against the reference page side by side; produces named screenshots and a report with numbered issues and a not-tested list.

evals.prompt: I publish a shadcn-style registry from this repo. 30 new components were added by workers in parallel. Before release, prove a consumer can actually install and render them.
evals.expected_output: Builds the registry against a local origin, creates a fresh app, inits from the style URL, adds every item with --overwrite using a real array of names, builds, runs axe on the installed app in both themes, and kills the file server by pid.
